description:
Flute & Sitar Music for Anxiety Relief | Deep Relaxation & a Calm Mind | 1.5 Hours

You're okay. Let the sitar say it first, and let the flute say it back.

This soft flute and sitar music, tuned to 432 Hz, is made for anxious mornings: loosening the knot in the chest, slowing the breath, and giving a racing mind somewhere quiet to land.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of Indian sitar and bamboo flute in Raga Ahir Bhairav over a steady tanpura drone, with no vocals and no ads interrupting.

▶ Stay in the calm - the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k-_9PNqaU2-Z_KhRN_X1hF
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing - it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for morning anxiety, deep relaxation, meditation, breathwork, journaling, gentle yoga, studying with a calm head, or background music for a quiet morning at home.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instruments: Sitar and Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Ahir Bhairav (a tender dawn raga)
Tuning: 432 Hz
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Soft, reassuring, unhurried
Atmosphere: Dawn light, a curtain lifting, a long breath out
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Press play before the day starts. Sit with your feet on the floor and let each flute phrase lengthen your out-breath. Stay until the chest feels wider.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Sitar opens, softly
9:00 The flute answers
18:00 Breath slowing
27:00 Chest opening
36:00 Letting go of the worry
45:00 A calm mind
54:00 Deep relaxation
1:03:00 Steady and safe
1:12:00 Light returning
1:21:00 Okay now

⏱ BEST FOR
• Anxiety relief
• Deep relaxation
• Morning meditation
• Breathwork
• Journaling
• Gentle yoga
• Calm background music

If this music helped you, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
